title: Radiators and Weather
author: Silas Underhill
blurb: Sable Crane, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
